core.title: Round Iron Coat Hook, Acorn AMZBP

text.description_html:
Acorn AMZBP, Round Iron Coat Hook

Made out of smooth black iron, the Round Iron Coat Hook is sturdy enough to hold even the thickest winter coats. The swirled hook catches on to coats to keep them from sliding off. The swirled end of this Acorn made hook is reminiscent of the curling tendrils of vines, adding a slightly natural element to something that might otherwise appear to be static.

Features and Specifications of the Round Coat Hook:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Material: Iron
  • Diameter: 1-5/16"

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 hook with square mount and mounting screws.
